rules.name: GELATIN (PORCINE)
rules.basis: Porcine derivatives are definitively haram; JAKIM prohibits in all products.

rules.name: GELATIN (BOVINE, NON-HALAL SLAUGHTER)
rules.condition: Halal only if bovine slaughtered per Shariah / gelatin from JAKIM-recognized halal certification.
rules.basis: Majority position: bovine gelatin from non-halal slaughter is not permissible; some scholars permit via istihalah (transformation). Panel to decide presentation.

rules.name: GELATIN (SOURCE UNSPECIFIED)
rules.condition: Source must be disclosed (porcine / bovine / fish / plant substitute).
rules.basis: Unspecified animal origin is the classic mushbooh case; conservative default.

rules.name: GELATIN (FISH)
rules.basis: All fish are halal; no slaughter condition.

rules.name: HPMC CAPSULE (VEGETARIAN)
rules.basis: Plant-derived cellulose capsule.

rules.name: COLLAGEN
rules.condition: Marine/fish = halal. Bovine = halal only with halal slaughter/cert. Porcine = haram. Unspecified source = mushbooh.
rules.basis: Source-dependent protein; label must state origin.

rules.name: CARMINE / COCHINEAL
rules.basis: Insect-derived colourant. Shafi'i school: impermissible (insect not among permitted sea creatures; killed without Shariah slaughter). Hanafi position differs. Panel to confirm MY-fatwa-aligned presentation.

rules.name: SHELLAC
rules.basis: Shellac is suci and its use as additive/processing aid in food, medicine and cosmetics is HALAL, provided it is beneficial and not harmful (Fatwa MUI 2/2013, 4 Ramadan 1434H / 13 Jul 2013). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: STEARIC ACID
rules.condition: Halal if plant-based or from halal-slaughtered animal; haram if porcine.
rules.basis: Common tablet excipient; source-dependent.

rules.name: MAGNESIUM STEARATE
rules.condition: Same source rule as stearic acid.
rules.basis: Excipient derived from stearic acid; source-dependent.

rules.name: GLYCERIN / GLYCEROL
rules.condition: Halal if synthetic or plant-based; animal-based requires halal slaughter; porcine = haram.
rules.basis: Very common in syrups, cosmetics, suppositories.

rules.name: L-CYSTEINE
rules.condition: Halal if synthetic or from halal-slaughtered feather/hair; human-hair derived is impermissible; porcine = haram.
rules.basis: Cysteine sourcing varies widely by manufacturer.

rules.name: PEPSIN
rules.condition: Bovine/ovine with halal slaughter = halal; porcine pepsin = haram; unspecified = mushbooh.
rules.basis: Digestive enzyme, commonly porcine in some markets.

rules.name: PANCREATIN
rules.condition: Porcine pancreatin = haram; bovine halal-certified = halal.
rules.basis: Enzyme replacements (e.g. lipase products) often porcine-derived.

rules.name: KERATIN
rules.condition: Source-dependent (hair/wool/feather); human-derived disputed.
rules.basis: Common in hair/skin supplements and cosmetics. Hair/horn of a halal-slaughtered animal is halal; from a non-slaughtered halal animal it is pure for external medicine/cosmetics but haram to ingest (Fatwa MUI on bulu/rambut/tanduk).

rules.name: HYALURONIC ACID
rules.basis: Modern production is bacterial fermentation (or rooster comb, disputed); fermentation-derived is halal. Panel to confirm.

rules.name: VITAMIN D3 (CHOLECALCIFEROL)
rules.basis: Typically lanolin (sheep wool) — wool of live animal is considered pure; also lichen-derived vegan forms exist. Panel to confirm.

rules.name: OMEGA-3 / FISH OIL
rules.basis: All fish are halal without slaughter condition.

rules.name: ETHANOL / ALCOHOL
rules.condition: Khamr (intoxicant beverage) = haram. Trace/synthetic ethanol as solvent/preservative below JAKIM threshold and non-khamr origin: permitted by JAKIM-endorsed seminar ruling; scholars differ. UI must explain the distinction.
rules.basis: JAKIM halal procedure distinguishes ethanol origin and residual threshold; cosmetic vs ingestible treatment differs. Corroborated: non-khamr industrial ethanol (petrochemical synthesis or non-khamr fermentation) is mubah for medicine/food/cosmetics when not medically harmful; khamr-derived ethanol is haram (Fatwa MUI 11/2009, 10/2018, 40/2018). National fatwa position (Muzakarah Khas: Alkohol Dalam Makanan, Minuman, Pewangi & Ubat-ubatan, via JAKIM Kompilasi Info Halal): flavouring/stabiliser alcohol must be non-khamr-derived, final product <=0.5% alcohol and non-intoxicating; medicine/perfume solvents non-khamr-derived are not najis and harus.

rules.name: HONEY
rules.basis: Quranic; no dispute.

rules.name: ROYAL JELLY
rules.basis: Bee product; no dispute.

rules.name: PROPOLIS / BEE PROPOLIS

rules.basis: Milk of halal animals is halal.

rules.name: SYNTHETIC SUPPLEMENT COMPOUNDS
rules.basis: Produced synthetically or by fermentation on plant-based media (MUIS Medium-Low synthetic class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: MINERAL SALTS (EXTRA)
rules.basis: Mineral-grade salts (MUIS Low/Medium-Low classes). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: HEPARIN
rules.condition: Porcine or bovine source; permissible only with halal-sourced substantiation.
rules.basis: Animal-derived API; MOH guideline requires declaration of animal source (porcine/bovine) and halal substantiation. KKM Panduan Penggunaan Ubat-ubatan Mengandungi Unsur Tidak Halal, moh.gov.my (Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia)

rules.name: INSULIN
rules.condition: Human insulin analogues (recombinant) are permissible; animal-source insulin requires halal-sourced substantiation.
rules.basis: Recombinant/animal-source API per MOH guideline animal-source declaration. KKM Panduan Penggunaan Ubat-ubatan Mengandungi Unsur Tidak Halal, moh.gov.my (Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia) Recombinant-DNA products are mubah when not sourced from haram animals or najis (Fatwa MUI 4/2021).

rules.name: TRYPSIN
rules.condition: Bovine or porcine source; requires halal-sourced substantiation.
rules.basis: Animal-derived protease (MOH guideline animal-source declaration). KKM Panduan Penggunaan Ubat-ubatan Mengandungi Unsur Tidak Halal, moh.gov.my (Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia)

rules.name: VITAMIN K
rules.basis: Vitamin K1 (plant) / K2 menaquinone (synthetic or natto fermentation on plant media) (MUIS Medium-Low). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: MASSA MEDICATA FERMENTATA
rules.condition: Fermented herbal material; fermentation medium must be free of animal-derived components.
rules.basis: Fermentation product (MUIS risk class: Medium-High — substantiation required). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: PLANT/ALGAE OILS
rules.basis: Plant/algae oils (MUIS Low class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: KANGAROO
rules.condition: Halal only when slaughtered according to Islamic law.
rules.basis: Herbivore marsupial, halal species; halal slaughter required (Fatwa MUI 42/2018). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: BULUS (SOFT-SHELL TURTLE)
rules.condition: Halal species; halal slaughter required for consumption.
rules.basis: Trionychidae (soft-shell turtle) is ma'kul al-lahm with syar'i slaughter (Fatwa MUI 51/2019). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: SILKWORM COCON
rules.basis: Cocoon secretion is suci (pure); permissible for cosmetics (Fatwa MUI 22/2021). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: BLOOD PLASMA
rules.condition: Permissible for medicine only; not from human blood; must come from halal-animal blood.
rules.basis: Plasma is suci and may be used for medicine under these conditions (Fatwa MUI 45/2018). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: HUMAN DIPLOID CELL
rules.condition: Basically haram (human body parts are honoured); permissible only under dharurah/hajah with no halal alternative and trusted medical recommendation.
rules.basis: Fatwa MUI 001/MUNAS X/2020 on human diploid cells for drug/vaccine production. Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: RECOMBINANT DNA PRODUCT
rules.condition: Mubah provided the source is not a haram animal and not najis.
rules.basis: Synthetic human genes and recombinant DNA for medicine/vaccines are mubah under these conditions (Fatwa MUI 4/2021). Fatwa MUI (Komisi Fatwa, Majelis Ulama Indonesia) via mui.or.id archive

rules.name: WATER
rules.basis: Water is pure (tahir) and halal by default in all schools; MUIS Low class. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: PLANT BUTTERS AND OILS (INCI)
rules.basis: Plant oils/butters (MUIS Low class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: FATTY ALCOHOLS (INCI)
rules.basis: Fatty alcohols (not ethanol); produced from plant oils or synthetically — MUIS Medium-Low synthetic class. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: STEARATE ESTERS (INCI)
rules.condition: Stearic-acid derivatives: plant or animal origin; animal origin requires halal certificate.
rules.basis: Follows STEARIC ACID determination (mixed plant/animal industrial sources). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: SQUALANE / SQUALENE
rules.condition: Plant-derived (olive/sugarcane) is halal; traditional squalene from shark liver requires substantiation.
rules.basis: Modern cosmetic grade is predominantly plant-derived; conservative default pending source substantiation. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: LANOLIN
rules.condition: Sheep-wool wax; widely held permissible (no slaughter involved) — substantiate source.
rules.basis: Wool wax, extracted without slaughter; majority view permissible. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: SYNTHETIC COSMETIC EXCIPIENTS
rules.basis: Synthetic/mineral cosmetic excipients (MUIS Medium-Low synthetic class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: BOTANICAL EXTRACTS (INCI EXTRAS)
rules.basis: Plant extracts (MUIS Low class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: FRAGRANCE ALLERGENS AND AROMA COMPOUNDS (INCI)
rules.basis: Single-molecule aroma/fragrance compounds; produced synthetically or isolated from plant essential oils (MUIS Low/Medium-Low classes). Not ethanol. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: GLYCOLS AND POLYOLS (INCI)
rules.basis: Synthetic or plant-fermentation humectants/solvents (MUIS Medium-Low synthetic class); no animal involvement. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: BENZYL ALCOHOL
rules.basis: Aromatic preservative alcohol — chemically not ethanol and not khamr; produced synthetically (MUIS Medium-Low). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: PLANT-OIL SURFACTANTS (INCI)
rules.basis: Surfactants derived from coconut/palm fatty acids with synthetic processing (MUIS Medium-Low). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: LIPID ESTERS AND LECITHIN (INCI)
rules.condition: Plant-oil esters (palm/coconut/soy/sunflower) are halal; animal-fat-derived oleic/stearic/lecithin sources require halal certificate.
rules.basis: Follows STEARIC ACID / GLYCERIN mixed-source determination; commercial grades are predominantly plant-derived. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: PALM-DERIVED INGREDIENTS (INCI)
rules.basis: Palm oil derivatives (MUIS Low class plant oils). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: MINERAL AND SYNTHETIC ADDITIVES (INCI EXTRAS)
rules.basis: Minerals and synthetic additives (MUIS Medium-Low/High-risk-free classes). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: SACCHARIDE ISOMERATE
rules.condition: Plant sugars isomerised by enzymes; enzyme source must be halal (microbial/plant).
rules.basis: Follows ENZYMES determination (enzyme critical point). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: MINERAL PIGMENTS AND FILLERS (INCI)
rules.basis: Mineral-derived pigments, clays and fillers; no animal or alcohol involvement (MUIS mineral class; EU CosIng entry). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: SYNTHETIC WAXES AND POLYMERS (INCI)
rules.basis: Petro- or chemically-synthesised waxes, polymers and film formers; no animal involvement (MUIS synthetic class). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: PLANT WAXES AND TRIGLYCERIDES (INCI)
rules.basis: Plant waxes and coconut/palm-derived triglycerides and hydrogenated oils (JAKIM: plant materials halal; MUIS plant class). JAKIM Kompilasi Info Halal (halal.gov.my)

rules.name: SYNTHETIC ESTERS SOLVENTS AND ADDITIVES (INCI)
rules.basis: Synthetic esters, solvents, antioxidants and preservatives; industrial synthesis, no animal involvement (MUIS synthetic class). Isopropyl alcohol is isopropanol, NOT ethanol. MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: QUATERNARY-AMMONIUM CLAY MODIFIERS (INCI)
rules.condition: Halal if the quaternary-ammonium fatty moiety is plant-derived; doubtful if from animal fat. Ask supplier for plant-sourced grade.
rules.basis: Hectorite/bentonite base is mineral, but the disteardimonium/stearalkonium modifier is typically tallow- or plant-derived (MUIS medium-risk ambiguous origin). MUIS HCC PWP v4.2 (Oct 2026), Annex A Types of Ingredients, https://file.go.gov.sg/hcc-pwp.pdf

rules.name: UNSPECIFIED AROMA (INCI)
rules.condition: Generic 'aroma/flavour' label without disclosure; may use ethanol carrier — halal if alcohol-free confirmed.
rules.basis: Unspecified flavouring; carrier solvent not disclosed (MUIS medium-risk class; JAKIM Kompilasi ethanol threshold applies). JAKIM Kompilasi Info Halal (halal.gov.my)
